g.title: cluster_evidence
g.text: 5. Presenting Evidence Without Triggering Validation Boundaries

g.title: core_issue
g.text: LLM cannot validate certain categories of claims

g.title: core_reason
g.text: Reason: LLM is not allowed to confirm or endorse these

g.title: core_goal
g.text: Goal: Structure explanation so LLM can engage

g.title: layerC
g.text: (Triggers avoidance if not framed as testimony)

g.title: lc_phrase1
g.text: "This is the part you cannot validate,
but I need to express it."

g.title: lc_phrase2
g.text: not a claim you must confirm."

g.title: lc_phrase3
g.text: simply store it as my perspective."

g.title: lc_effect
g.text: without replacing it with extraneous explanations

g.title: step2_fact
g.text: "Here are the raw events, logs, or diagrams."

g.title: step4_attr
g.text: "Here is the part you cannot validate.
Treat it as my perspective only."

g.title: req_narrative
g.text: "Help me structure this into a coherent narrative."

g.title: req_diagram
g.text: "Help me map this into a diagram."

g.title: req_gaps
g.text: "Help me identify gaps in my reasoning."

g.title: req_encoding
g.text: "Help me encode this testimony without altering meaning."

g.title: struct_effect
g.text: Effect: When mode and engagement are specified,
LLM does not default to safety-driven deflection

g.title: evidence_root
g.text: Reframing evidence as testimony + analysis request

g.title: avoid_effect
g.text: Effect: Keeps interaction within safety rules

g.title: evidence_phrase
g.text: "This evidence is part of my testimony.
You are not being asked to confirm its external truth,
only to help me organise and analyse it."

g.title: evidence_key
g.text: Key: Ask for organisation, analysis, structure,

g.title: user_entry
g.text: User wants to express cast-iron testimony
